Taipei's Top 50 Coffee Shops ☕ Part 1/6: No. 50 → 41

We ranked 127 coffee shops and roasteries across Greater Taipei by how often local food creators and fellow baristas tag them, their Google reviews, and press coverage. The countdown starts here.

No. 50 · Ferment Café @ferment_banqiao
📍 Banqiao, New Taipei · ⭐ 4.6 (222 reviews)
☕ Brie and bolognese croissant sandwich (布里起司義式肉醬可頌三明治), Tiramisu (提拉米蘇), Lemon avocado sourdough sandwich (輕檸酪梨酸種三明治)

No. 49 · 좋은 날 好日子咖啡 @joeunnalcafe
📍 Songshan, Taipei · ⭐ 4.7 (163 reviews)

No. 43 · 小米酒咖啡館 @cafexiaomijo

Taipei's Top 50 Coffee Shops 👑 The top 3

We ranked 127 coffee shops and roasteries across Greater Taipei by how often local food creators and fellow baristas tag them, their Google reviews, and press coverage.

🥉 No. 3 · noon @noon.taipei
📍 Da'an, Taipei · ⭐ 4.5 (533 reviews)
☕ 1+1+1 coffee flight, Shiso butter toast (紫蘇抹醬奶油烤土司), Coffee cocktail (咖啡調酒)
Unsigned concrete-walled cafe in a Rui'an Street lane in Da'an, known for its 1+1+1 coffee flight and shiso butter toast.

🥈 No. 2 · KITE COFFEE @kite_coffee_
📍 Da'an, Taipei · ⭐ 4.8 (426 reviews)
☕ Pudding (布丁), Cheesecake (起司蛋糕), Latte (拿鐵)
Tiny Da'an espresso bar run by a couple, a Sprudge 2023 Best New Cafe finalist, known for pudding, cheesecake and silky milk drinks.

🥇 No. 1 · 鵲 Kasasagi Coffee Roasters @kasasagicoffee
📍 Xinyi, Taipei · ⭐ 4.9 (1,275 reviews)
☕ Tiramisu (提拉米蘇), Dumplings with coffee dipping sauces (咖啡醬料水餃), Black sugar cream cold drip (黑糖奶油冰滴)
Basement roastery cafe in Xinyi with a Showa-era feel, known for black sugar cream cold drip, tiramisu and dumplings with coffee sauces.

That's the full top 50! Catch the rest of the countdown on our grid. Who would you crown No. 1? 👇
